OpenPlexer v0.1.0-rc.1 is a pre-alpha release candidate.

- The published Apple silicon binaries passed the hook, policy, audit, and macOS install checks. The sandbox blocked the live hub HTTP listener. The offline multi-agent test used substitutes for the agents and processes.
- Supported agent versions are Claude Code 2.1.327 and Codex 0.169.0, based on recorded runs on earlier source builds.
- The local rebuild produced all five archives. Its hashes differed from the published hashes. Reproduction with Go 1.27.4 remains unverified.
- Hooks cover selected tools. The hub holds data for one team. Trusted audit checkpoints cover records only through their signed count. The Windows install remains unverified.

[Full checks, supported versions, and known limits](https://github.com/Multiplexer-si/OpenPlexer/blob/main/docs/releases/v0.1.0-rc.1.md)
